intro: This page covers MCO’s official Parking Garages A, B, and C, Terminal Top, Valet, and the North Park Place, South Park Place, and West Park economy lots, with rates copied from the official flymco.com parking pages on November 24, 2026. The garages cap at $24 per 24 hours and the economy lots at $14; Garage C is the only official garage you can reserve ($32 per 24 hours online). The train-station surface lots were left out. Below the official lots are nine off-airport options: five independent shuttle lots (The Parking Spot, Fast Park & Relax, Drive & Park, OMNI, and Gold Park) and four nearby hotels whose own pages describe a park-and-fly package. We included only operators that publish a street address and parking details on their own pages, so this is a sample, not every lot near the airport. Hotel shuttle hours vary, so check before an early or late flight. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

hours.notes: The official page lists rates and a 45-day maximum stay but does not publish operating hours.

officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-24. Maximum stay 45 days. Payment: cash, Discover, American Express, MasterCard, Visa, E-PASS, SunPass Plus. The official site says reservations guarantee a space in Garage C.
officialLots.visitNotes: Most spaces are covered per the official page. EV charging: Level 3, Rows 59–62 and Level 5, Rows 59, 60 and 62. Patrolled by the Orlando Police Department – Airport Division.

listings.name: The Parking Spot Orlando (MCO)
listings.area: Hazeltine National Dr off S. Semoran Blvd, next to the Renaissance Orlando Airport Hotel; 1.4 miles to the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s Orlando page says “we’re open 24/7” and lists a 24/7 shuttle to and from MCO.

listings.shuttle: The shuttle picks you up at your vehicle and helps with luggage; the page lists a 24/7 shuttle and says it serves Terminals A, B, and C.
offers: Premium covered (8' clearance; first drop-off on return)
listings.visitNotes: From S. Semoran Blvd, turn west on Hazeltine National Dr. Entry is by scanning your reservation QR code. The page says reservations can be changed up to 1 hour before check-in.
listings.feeNotes: The page title says Orlando rates start from $12.95/day (as listed on 2026-11-24); your price depends on dates in the reservation tool.

sources.label: The Parking Spot Orlando location page

listings.name: Fast Park & Relax Orlando (MCO)
listings.area: N. Frontage Road near the airport; about 5 minutes to the airport by shuttle per the operator

hours.notes: The operator’s Orlando page says the lot is “Open & Staffed 24/7.”

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle; the page gives an average ride of about 5 minutes in normal conditions and says drivers help with luggage.
listings.visitNotes: On 2026-11-24 the page carried a notice that the lot was at capacity for holiday parking reservations and that guests without a reservation would be accommodated as space allows. The listed phone is the Orlando manager’s line; the company line is 1-877-806-7275. The page’s “FastCharge” service is not described as EV charging.
listings.feeNotes: The page showed a daily parking rate of $15.21, excluding taxes and airport fees (as listed on 2026-11-24).

listings.name: Drive & Park MCO
listings.area: Narcoossee Road east of the airport; the operator gives 2.7 to 3.5 miles to MCO on different pages

hours.notes: The home page says “Open 24/7/365.” The contact page says the shuttle runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

listings.shuttle: Free air-conditioned shuttle with luggage help. The contact page says it runs 24/7 to and from Terminal A (call on return and a shuttle will be waiting); the home page says it serves all terminals.
listings.visitNotes: Locally owned per the site. On 2026-11-24 the site said its online reservation system was down because of a Cloudflare outage and asked customers to call to book. The home page also lists (689) 686-3476.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-24: $5.99/day (+tax/fees) booked online; walk-in $9.99/day.

listings.name: OMNI Airport Parking Orlando
listings.area: Narcoossee Road east of the airport; about a 6-minute shuttle ride to MCO per the operator

hours.notes: The home page says “Open 24/7” and “24/7 Always Open.”

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle to and from MCO every 10–15 minutes, about a 6-minute ride, per the operator.
listings.visitNotes: Paved, fenced, well-lit lot with 24/7 video monitoring per the site. Check-in is by QR code; monthly members can use a license-plate-triggered gate.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-24: $8.99 daily rate; holiday rates starting at $15.99/day; monthly parking $120/month (+tax) with the second month 50% off.

listings.name: Gold Park Orlando
listings.area: Narcoossee Road east of the airport

hours.notes: The site does not publish lot or shuttle hours.

listings.shuttle: Free shuttle to MCO; the site lists a shuttle service time of 15 minutes. Show your confirmation email on arrival.
listings.visitNotes: The site spells the street “Narcoosee Rd.” It also advertises RV, boat, and trailer storage.
listings.feeNotes: The home page does not publish a dated daily rate; prices appear in the booking tool.

listings.name: Comfort Suites Orlando International Airport
listings.area: McCoy Road west of the airport; about 2 miles from MCO per the hotel

hours.notes: The hotel page does not publish parking-lot hours for park-and-fly guests.

listings.shuttle: Free round-trip MCO shuttle daily from 4:30 a.m. to 1:30 a.m.; hourly departures from the hotel, and airport pickup on request (call 407-812-9100 after you collect your bags). Not 24 hours, per the hotel.
offers: Park and Fly – up to 7 nights of parking
Park and Fly – up to 30 nights of parking
listings.visitNotes: Packages must be booked under an eligible package rate, and a signed damage waiver is required, per the hotel page.
listings.feeNotes: The hotel page says additional parking is available for $7.99 per night with the 30-day package (as listed on 2026-11-24). Package prices are not published.
